text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — want to lock owners/timelines for the three remediation tracks: quota, scheduler tuning, headroom. TL;DR: incidents are clustering around nightly batch spikes + slow autoscale cooldowns.
kevin: I can own the cloud quota request. Will open the formal ticket and ping sales-eng for priority. Target: file request today, expect vendor reply 3-7 business days. @maya any required justification doc you want attached? :thumbsup:
rachel: I'll take scheduler tuning. Need the HPA/VPA configs and recent scale event logs. Can someone paste the autoscaler error snippet from last night?
maya: copying the snippet from ops logs below — last scale failed due to pod-scheduling timeout then queued requests spiked.
maya: ```
time="2026-02-10T03:12:08Z" level=error msg="scale failed" err="0/8 nodes available: insufficient gpu, 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate"
...
```
tom: I'll own headroom planning (short + medium term). Proposal: add 20% reserved headroom on peak GPU pools, and run a 2-week soak with synthetic load. Will draft runbook. ETA: proposal on Monday.
kevin: For the quota ticket I'm going to include recent utilization graphs and a simple PRD. Maya — paste the perf graphs link?
maya: https://redwood-internal/graphs/gpu-util/last30d — peak pattern around 02:00 UTC most days, correlates with nightly batch jobs. Also attached the postmortem doc: https://redwood-internal/pm/gpu-capacity-pm-2026-02
rachel: Scheduler tuning notes — initial ideas: reduce scale-down stabilization window from 10m -> 3m for the batch worker pool, add nodeAffinity to prefer GPU-capable nodes, and add a small buffer to the pod resource request so scheduler picks nodes quicker. I'll prototype in staging first.
kevin: Filed ticket CLOUD-5912 and assigned to cloud-requests. Included graphs and PM link. ETA vendor response 5 business days. Link: https://tickets.redwood/CLOUD-5912
infra-bot: Reminder: Incident follow-up checklist created — https://infra.redwood/checklists/gpu-capacity-followup — assigned owners: quota=CLOUD-5912, scheduler=ENG-4321, headroom=ENG-4322
tom: Can we set a weekly 30m sync for the three owners and oncall to review metrics until remediation is complete? Propose Wed 10:00 PT.
maya: Wed 10 PT works for me. I'll add a calendar and invite owners + oncall. Also adding a recurring alert to watch 'pending pods > 5 for > 5m' during 01:00-04:00 UTC window.
rachel: Putting a draft PR for the HPA change: https://git.redwood/infra/hpa/pulls/17 — will not deploy to prod until we validate in staging and run the soak.
kevin: Once CLOUD-5912 gets vendor approval I'll request accelerated quota if needed and update this thread.
maya: Action items summary: 1) Kevin — CLOUD-5912 quota ticket (5bd ETA). 2) Rachel — scheduler tuning PR & staging soak (PR up, testing). 3) Tom — headroom plan + 2-week soak (proposal Mon). 4) Maya — calendar + recurring alert + attach postmortem. Weekly sync Wed 10 PT. We'll mark ENG-4321/4322 with these owners. Ping here when each item moves. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Acked.
rachel: Ack.
tom: Ack.
infra-bot: Updated incident tracker: https://infra.redwood/incident/2026-02-gpu-capacity -> status: remediation in progress
maya: Thanks all — keeping this open until all three tickets are closed. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate to oncall or drop a note here.
